correctness.rationale: Formal generating function G_k(z)=z(1-z)/(1-3z+z^2+z^{k+1}) is obtained exactly from recurrence. Expand before the second correction (n<=2k+2) to a 6-periodic Fibonacci coefficient minus a fixed convolution coefficient. For k>=14, the first sixteen post-k terms are within this range, giving the six explicit first-hit offsets. Eleven remaining k=3..13 are certified by complete bounded recurrence enumeration and k=2 by a full eight-step modular period. A separate stdlib checker reproduces all coefficient rows and enumerates every earlier index for k=2..2000. Finite computational checks are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact loss-of-obstruction index is a natural nontrivial invariant of the residue class needed by all integer Wagstaff-type expressions with odd exponent. Rather than a few modulus-eight examples, the result gives a sharp full infinite-parameter classification with six distinct stable parameter phases and exceptional small-parameter delays, identifying how far a published k+1 modular sieve extends before becoming powerless. It does not repeat or purport to strengthen the already established prime-exponent nonexistence theorem; its value is a precise structural local cutoff for broader exponent questions.
